Hi Cory / Elena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps we discussed so we’re aligned:

- Goal: 2-week technical pilot to validate RAG fit for NovusCare’s clinical knowledge base (policies, FAQs, SOPs) + measure grounding precision and hallucination regression.
- Scope: ~250k docs (PDFs + internal Confluence exports), expected active queries: 3–5k/day, 99th-pctl latency target for user-facing flows < 800ms.
- Data ask: please send a 1k-doc sample + 200 red-team prompts (we can use the attached prompt set template).

Model / eval starting point (recommendations):
- Candidate generator / embedder: redwood-embed-2k (Dense embeddings, 2k token context awareness).
- Retriever: dense ANN store (we recommend Faiss/IVF-HNSW on snapshot VMs) with 500-token chunking, 50-token overlap.
- Candidate K: retrieve top 50 (k=50) to allow reranker headroom.
- Reranker: cross-enc-redwood-rerank-v1 (cross-encoder) for final ordering — helps reduce hallucination and improve grounding precision.
- Generation model for responses: redwood-13b-v2-q4 as baseline (cost-friendly); fallback to redwood-34b-v1 for high-precision flows if needed.

Metrics to track during pilot: grounding precision @ top-1/top-3, hallucination rate (binary judged), MRR, recall@k (k=50), median and 95th latency.

Attached: prompt set template (novuscare_promptset_v1.csv) and a short eval plan (novuscare_rag_eval_plan_v1.pdf). Also linking our quick benchmark summary here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ExampleBenchmarkLink

Next steps we agreed on the call:
1) NovusCare: share sample docs + procurement contact (cc procurement@novuscare.ai) — ETA EOD Fri 9/10.
2) Redwood: provision sandbox vector DB + evaluation harness, upload sample, run baseline retrieval + reranker config (ETA Mon 9/13).
3) Sync call: short status check Tue 9/14 9am PT (I’ll send calendar invite).

Ben and Laura — looping you in to own the sandbox wiring and the reranker configuration. Monica — can you own scheduling and procurement thread once Cory confirms contact?

Thanks,

Cory — good questions, answered inline below.

> 1) Chunking: you recommend 500 tokens / 50 overlap — is that tuned for legal/clinical docs specifically, or a general starting point?
That’s our empirically safe starting point for clinical SOPs where context windows matter. For table-heavy PDFs we often increase token overlap to 150 and reduce chunk size to 300 so rows don’t get split unpredictably. We’ll review a 50-doc sample and propose the final chunk/overlap parameters in the sandbox run.

> 2) Embeddings: how much difference vs text-sim-1?
redwood-embed-2k is tuned for longer contexts and semantic structure common in procedural docs. In our benchmarks it improves recall@50 by ~6–10% on clinical/process corpora vs generic text-sim models. I’ll attach a short micro-benchmark in the sandbox run so you can see delta on your data.

> 3) Reranker cost: cross-encoder at k=50 looks expensive — rough per-query tradeoff?
Correct — cross-enc at full k=50 is heavier. Options:
- Baseline: retrieve k=50 with a cheap bi-encoder and then run cross-encoder on top-10 only (recommended sweet spot).
- Progressive rerank: run a lightweight pointwise scorer to prune to top-20, then cross-enc on top-10.
- Cost numbers (very rough): bi-encoder retrieval + cross-enc@10 on redwood-13b-v2-q4 path is ~0.9x of full cross-enc@50; full cross-enc@50 can be 2.5–3x depending on model choice. We’ll produce exact pilot cost estimates after we ingest the sample.

Pilot configuration I propose for the sandbox run:
- Chunk: 400 tokens / 100 overlap (compromise for tables)
- Embedding: redwood-embed-2k
- Retrieve: ANN k=50; prune to 12 via pointwise scorer; cross-enc final rerank on top-10
- Gen model: redwood-13b-v2-q4 for latency-sensitive flows, redwood-34b-v1 in a conservative path for final answer verification.

I’ll put the proposed evaluation rubric in the sandbox run so you see grounding precision and per-model cost/latency.

—Priya

Quick engineering notes from the solutions side:

- Latency expectations: with the progressive rerank plan (cross-enc on top-10) we expect median tail latency for the end-to-end call (embed+retrieve+rerank+generate) around 450–650ms on Dedicated 1xA100 equivalent. Peak SLA headroom will depend on concurrency; we’ll size the sandbox for 50 qps to capture throughput behavior.
- Cost / model trade: redwood-13b-v2-q4 + cross-enc-v1 is the best cost/precision balance for pilot. If grounding precision target < 95% at top-1 we recommend switching to 34b for the verification path only (i.e., run verification pass asynchronously).
- Caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated queries and short-term answer cache (TTL 24h) for FAQs to reduce cost.

I’ll start the sandbox infra ticket today and wire in the Faiss snapshot. Ben — can you help with the reranker recipe (thresholds for pointwise prune)?

thanks,
Laura
